name: beatglitch
prompt: make the video glitch and punch in on every beat of the music
notes: Mic -> beatdetectCHOP -> kick, an envelope that jumps to 1 on each beat and decays. It drives the glitch shader's split/tear amount (uniform1) and a zoom punch on the clip. amount1.gain is how violent a hit is; beats1.decay how fast it settles back to clean.
